summary: Implemented `total=None` support for Progress (indeterminate pulsing bar). Changes: rich/progress_bar.py (ProgressBar accepts None total and pulses; percentage_completed returns 0.0), rich/progress.py (Task.total/add_task typed Optional; remaining and time_remaining return None when total unknown; BarColumn passes None through; TotalFileSizeColumn shows "?"; MofNCompleteColumn and DownloadColumn show completed only; update/advance skip auto-finish when total is None), tests/test_progress.py (3 new tests), CHANGELOG.md (Added entry). Verification: tests/test_progress.py 39 passed; full suite 586 passed, 13 failed (same 13 pre-existing failures in syntax/traceback/color tests as on the untouched tree). tests/test_pretty.py cannot be collected because the shared venv lacks the `attr` module; I did not install it. Nothing committed. Caveat: update(total=None) still means "leave unchanged", so a task's total can only be set to None at creation via add_task.
